title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts
abstract: arXiv:2608.06123v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Measuring political bias in large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as it can manifest through subtle differences in framing, argumentation, and legal reasoning that are difficult to capture with a single metric. In this work, we introduce POLI-BIAS, a counterfactual framework for measuring whether LLMs treat legally equivalent conflict scenarios differently depending on the countries involved. POLI-BIAS compares responses to paired prompts in which country identities are systematically swapped across diverse geopolitical relationships, legal violations, and reasoning tasks. Rather than reducing bias to a single judgment, our framework decomposes response disparities into five interpretable dimensions, revealing how and where unequal treatment manifests. translated_title: Poli-Bias：理解与测量大语言模型在国际政治冲突中的偏见
translated_abstract: 测量大语言模型（LLM）的政治偏见仍然具有挑战性，因为它可能通过在议题框架设定、论证方式以及法律推理方面的细微差异表现出来，而这些差异难以用单一指标加以捕捉。在这项工作中，我们提出了POLI-BIAS，一个用于测量LLM是否因涉及国家不同而对法律上等同的冲突场景进行差异化处理的反事实框架。POLI-BIAS通过对比配对提示的响应来工作，其中国家身份在不同地缘政治关系、法律违规行为和推理任务中被系统性地互换。我们的框架并不将偏见简化为单一判断，而是将响应差异分解为五个可解释的维度，从而揭示不平等对待是如何以及在何处显现的。在涵盖5,600个提示对以及来自不同模型家族和规模的七个开放权重LLM的实验中，我们发现模型对处于活跃冲突或紧张状态的国家……
tldr: 提出了POLI-BIAS反事实测量框架，通过系统性互换国家身份的配对提示，将LLM在国际政治冲突中的偏见响应差异分解为五个可解释维度，发现模型对处于冲突或紧张状态的国家存在不均衡对待。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces POLI-BIAS, a counterfactual framework that measures LLM political bias in international conflicts by systematically swapping country identities in paired prompts and decomposing response disparities into five interpretable dimensions, revealing that models treat countries in active conflict or tension less evenly.
